summary: Infrastructure verification for VS Code (code-server) 502 Bad Gateway fix. Confirmed supervisor programs code-server and nginx-code-proxy are RUNNING. localhost:1111 (nginx proxy) and localhost:8080 (code-server) both respond with HTTP 302 redirect (expected PASS for code-server login redirect). Repo codebase at /app is intact: /app/backend contains all expected files (bot.py, engine.py, charting.py, analysis.py, config.py, storage.py, sessions.py, qx.py, ticks.py, requirements.txt, pyquotex/, frontend/, images/, data/). No default Emergent boilerplate remains: no /app/frontend React app and no /app/backend/server.py. Backend and frontend supervisor services intentionally left STOPPED per user request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a backend-only Python bot repo (Quotex/Telegram charting). No FastAPI server, no React frontend, no MongoDB models. The backend & frontend supervisor programs are intentionally STOPPED — do not start them. code-server serves VS Code UI on port 1111 via nginx proxy; a 302 redirect to /login is the expected healthy state.
rca of the issue: Root cause: prior `supervisorctl stop all` invocation stopped the code-server and nginx-code-proxy supervisor programs, causing the external VS Code URL to return 502 Bad Gateway (no upstream). Mitigation: restarted both programs via supervisorctl. Verified: `sudo supervisorctl status` shows code-server RUNNING (pid 1721) and nginx-code-proxy RUNNING (pid 1823); curl to localhost:1111 and localhost:8080 both return 302 (healthy).
